title: Mask2Former
paper_title: Masked-attention Mask Transformer for Universal Image Segmentation
core_mech: 上一层预测 mask 反向约束下一层 query cross-attention 的迭代集合分割。
core_mech_en: Iterative set-prediction segmentation where predicted foreground masks from layer l-1 constrain query cross-attention in layer l.
output_desc: 一组带类别的二值 mask，可统一实例、语义与全景分割
output_en: Set of class-labeled binary masks unifying semantic, instance, and panoptic segmentation

source.title: Mask2Former
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

adapter.name: Mask2Former (masked-attention mechanism)
adapter.mechanism: Query masks restrict cross-attention; bipartite matching supervises class/mask/dice set predictions.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Small convolution pixel decoder replaces multi-scale deformable attention; semantic foreground/background targets, not panoptic instance annotations.
Matching, mask attention and set losses are real; the full Detectron2 pipeline is not reproduced.
